title: Reference-informed Visual Style: live-action
description: Matched visual-style authoring case using one illustrated Subject reference; compare baseline and candidate writer instructions with identical inputs.
humanReview: Does Auto infer the illustrated medium, or does the explicit preset preserve its chosen medium?
Does the opening give a few distinctive evidenced appearance traits rather than a bare medium declaration or canned adjectives?
For anime, are supported line, facial, hair or shadow traits useful without becoming a mandatory inventory?
For live action, are identity, outfit and palette translated without requiring illustrated cel outlines?
Are Subject-only evidence boundaries respected, without copying sheet panels, poses, expressions or camera into global style?
Are unsupported production claims absent and both shots, motion and temporal progression still clear?
